title: Poolside in Cholon: a friend and Ron Tototz
description: Two young men in swim trunks pose arm-on-shoulder by the door of the French swimming pool in Cholon, the Chinese district of Saigon — at left a man Larry knew well but whose name he can't recall, at right Ron Tototz. The older man reading in the lawn chair was, in Larry's words, "just a person there." Same visit as VN-0004.
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0005-c18035136.json and -c18035487.json). The unnamed man at left is the guitarist of the guitar-session series (VN-0003/VN-0007/VN-0008) per Larry — one identification would resolve both. He is someone Larry 'knew really well'; recovering his name is a standing interview goal.
